name: mmseg CNN classics
plain: The MMSegmentation authors' ADE20K checkpoints of FCN, PSPNet, DeepLabV3, DeepLabV3+ and HRNet, convolutional scene segmentation.
summary: The mmsegmentation ADE20K checkpoints of the CNN classics: FCN, PSPNet, DeepLabV3 and DeepLabV3+ on a dilated ResNet-101 (output stride 8), and HRNetV2-W48 with an FCN head; networks vendored from mmsegmentation (no mmseg / mmcv dependency).

papers.title: Fully Convolutional Networks for Semantic Segmentation
Rethinking Atrous Convolution for Semantic Image Segmentation
Encoder-Decoder with Atrous Separable Convolution for Semantic Image Segmentation
Deep High-Resolution Representation Learning for Visual Recognition
